title: The History of Red Dead Redemption | Revolver to Redemption 2 and Beyond | Gaming History
description: The full history of Rockstar's Red Dead series: Red Dead Revolver, Red Dead Redemption, Undead Nightmare, Red Dead Redemption 2, Red Dead Online, the new ports and the sales milestones.

sections.heading: Welcome to the Wild West
sections.script: A lone rider on a ridge, a campfire in the distance and a frontier that is slowly disappearing. The Red Dead series from Rockstar Games has taken players into the American Old West for more than twenty years. It started with a quick draw action game, grew into an open world classic, and then became one of the biggest and most admired games ever made. In this video we walk through the full history of the franchise: Red Dead Revolver in two thousand four, Red Dead Redemption in twenty ten, Red Dead Redemption 2 in twenty eighteen, plus Red Dead Online, the ports, and the sales milestones that keep climbing. Grab your hat and your horse, because the frontier is calling.

sections.heading: Red Dead Revolver
sections.script: The story begins as a project that almost never reached players. Red Dead Revolver began around two thousand with the studio Angel Studios and funding from the Japanese publisher Capcom, as a spiritual successor to the arcade shooter Gun dot Smoke. Development was troubled, and Capcom cancelled the game. Then Rockstar Games stepped in. Take-Two, the parent company of Rockstar, bought Angel Studios, which was renamed Rockstar San Diego, and Rockstar took over the rights and finished the game. Red Dead Revolver arrived on the PlayStation 2 and Xbox in May of two thousand four. It follows a bounty hunter named Red Harlow, in a linear, level based adventure set in the eighteen eighties. Reviews were mixed and sales were moderate, but the seed was planted.

sections.heading: Red Dead Redemption
sections.script: Six years later, Rockstar San Diego went much bigger. Red Dead Redemption launched in May of twenty ten for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. Instead of short levels, it gave players a huge open world across New Austin, West Elizabeth and the Mexican state of Nuevo Paraiso. You play John Marston, a former outlaw whose family is held by government agents in nineteen eleven, and who must hunt down the members of his old gang. The game added the honor system, which tracks your good and bad deeds, and the Dead Eye ability, which slows time so you can mark targets. Critics loved the visuals, the music and the story, and many named it Game of the Year. It is still remembered for one of the most powerful endings in gaming.

sections.heading: Undead Nightmare and the DLC
sections.script: After launch, Rockstar kept the frontier busy. Free and paid downloadable content added new multiplayer modes and missions, including Outlaws to the End in June of twenty ten, and Legends and Killers, which brought characters from Red Dead Revolver into multiplayer. The biggest surprise was Undead Nightmare, a zombie expansion that follows John Marston as he searches for a cure for a plague that has infected his family. It is not part of the main story, and it turned the wild west into a horror comedy with undead horses and strange creatures to hunt. Fans loved it so much that it later became a standalone game, and a Game of the Year edition packed all the content together. For many players, this was the moment Red Dead became a true franchise.

sections.heading: The long wait
sections.script: Then came a very long wait. For years fans asked for a sequel, a PC version, or even a remaster. Rockstar was busy with Grand Theft Auto Five and its online mode, and the cowboys stayed quiet. Players did get one small gift in twenty sixteen, when Red Dead Redemption became playable on Xbox One through backward compatibility, and it was one of the most requested games for that feature. Red Dead Redemption had sold more than fifteen million copies by twenty seventeen, which proved the audience was still there. Finally, in October of twenty sixteen, Rockstar officially announced a new Red Dead game, and the community went wild. Two more years of trailers, screenshots and waiting followed, as the studio worked on its largest world yet.

sections.heading: Red Dead Redemption 2
sections.script: Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived on October twenty sixth, twenty eighteen, for the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. It is a prequel, set mostly in eighteen ninety nine, and it follows Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as the age of outlaws comes to an end. The world is far larger than the first game, with five states, including Ambarino, New Hanover, Lemoyne with the city of Saint Denis, and the returning New Austin and West Elizabeth. Every detail was built for realism, from the way horses react to the way camps change over time. Critics gave it huge praise for its story, characters, world and graphics. Many critics call it one of the greatest games ever made.

sections.heading: Record breaking sales
sections.script: The numbers were just as big as the game. Take-Two reported that Red Dead Redemption 2 earned about seven hundred twenty five million dollars in its first three days, which was the biggest opening weekend in entertainment history at that time, from a company announcement. It sold more than twenty three million copies in its first two weeks. The game reached PC on November fifth, twenty nineteen, with better graphics options and a huge fan following. Over the years it kept selling, passing fifty million, then eighty million copies, and Take-Two now reports more than eighty five million units sold in. That puts it among the best selling games of all time.

sections.heading: Red Dead Online
sections.script: Red Dead Redemption 2 also came with an online world. Red Dead Online launched in beta on November twenty seventh, twenty eighteen, and left beta with a full release on May fifteenth, twenty nineteen. It is set one year before the single player story, in eighteen ninety eight, and you play a custom character who clears their name after being framed. The online world added roles such as bounty hunter, trader, collector and moonshiner, plus posses, events and regular updates. Reviews of the beta were mixed, but later content updates made it more popular. In December of twenty twenty, Rockstar also released Red Dead Online as a standalone game, so new players could jump in without buying the full story game.

sections.heading: Ports and remasters
sections.script: After years of requests, Red Dead Redemption finally came back. In August of twenty twenty three, Rockstar announced that the first game, together with Undead Nightmare, would arrive on the Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 on August seventeenth, priced at forty nine ninety nine dollars. It was a port, not a full remaster, which divided fans. The PC version followed in October of twenty twenty four. Then, in November of twenty twenty five, Rockstar announced yet another wave: on December second, the game came to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series consoles, Nintendo Switch 2, and to Android and iOS through Netflix. Upgrades included sharper resolution and sixty frames per second. Owners of the earlier versions could upgrade for free, which was a welcome surprise.

sections.heading: Legacy and what comes next
sections.script: Today the Red Dead series has sold more than one hundred million copies, and Take-Two reports nearly one hundred sixteen million units for the whole franchise. The games set a new standard for storytelling, open worlds and detail, and they proved that a quiet Western can compete with any action blockbuster. As for the future, Rockstar has not announced a new Red Dead game. Right now, all eyes are on Grand Theft Auto Six, so any talk about a new Red Dead is only a wish from the fans. What we do know is that John Marston and Arthur Morgan have earned a permanent place in gaming history. This is a series that rewards patience, and players are still finding new corners of the map today.

sections.heading: Your favorite rider
sections.script: From a rescued Capcom project in two thousand four to a franchise with more than a hundred million copies sold, the Red Dead series has come a long way. Revolver gave us the spark, Redemption gave us John Marston, and Redemption 2 gave us Arthur Morgan and one of the most detailed worlds ever built. Now we want to hear from you. Which Red Dead game is your favorite, and would you rather see a remake of Redemption 2 or an all new story? Do you remember where you were for that final ride? Tell us in the comments. If you enjoyed this history, like the video and subscribe for more gaming history, and we will see you down the trail, partner.
